title: Marlowe Rewards Benefit Schedule: Member Treatment of Investigation Holds
content:
On the replacement of a locked Gift Cards & Store Credit card, the investigation hold receives the member treatment of the holder's Marlowe Rewards standing on the replacement date.

| Marlowe Rewards tier | Membership enrolled at least | Treatment of the investigation hold |
|---|---|---|
| Gold, Platinum, Icon or Atelier | 24 whole months earlier | Multiplied by 0.5 and rounded down to the whole dollar |
| Silver | 12 whole months earlier | Multiplied by 0.75 and rounded up to the cent |
| Any other tier or tenure, or no membership | — | Kept as worked out |

Tier and enrolment date are read from the holder's Marlowe Rewards membership; tenure is counted in whole months from the enrolment date to the replacement date.

## Worked figures (hypothetical holds)

| Holder | Hold as worked out | Treated hold |
|---|---|---|
| Gold, 30 months | 16.00 | 8.00 |
| Gold, 30 months | 16.90 | 8.00 (8.45 rounded down to the whole dollar) |
| Platinum, 20 months | 16.90 | 16.90 (tenure below 24 months) |
| Silver, 14 months | 10.01 | 7.51 (7.5075 rounded up to the cent) |
| Silver, 11 months | 10.01 | 10.01 |
| Member (entry tier), 60 months | 10.01 | 10.01 |
